title: CertaPro Painters of Ocala vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing CertaPro Painters of Ocala with Precision Paint Experts? How to plan an Ocala exterior repaint around heat, humidity, storms, and dry time.
h1: CertaPro Painters of Ocala vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: In Ocala, the calendar matters almost as much as the contractor. This guide helps you compare how bidders plan exterior work around Florida weather.

secondary: best time to paint a house in florida
questions: What is the best time of year to paint a house exterior in Ocala?
How do painters deal with afternoon storms in Florida?

sections.h2: Weather is part of every Ocala bid
body: CertaPro Painters of Ocala is one of the painting and property-service companies Ocala homeowners may be comparing. For exterior work in Marion County, a big part of what you are buying is a plan for the weather. Sun, humidity, dew, and fast-building afternoon storms all affect when paint can go on and how well it cures. Asking every bidder how they schedule around those conditions tells you a lot about how the job will go.
What follows is a set of scheduling questions you can bring to any contractor, plus the specific timing Precision Paint Experts writes into its estimates.

sections.h2: The exterior season, and working outside it
body: The best exterior season here runs from October through May, when temperatures and humidity are kinder to fresh coatings. That does not mean summer is off limits. When we paint exteriors in summer, crews start earlier in the day and keep an eye on dew point and radar, so coatings are not going on surfaces that will be wet before they set. Our article on how weather affects house painting in Florida goes deeper on the science.

sections.h2: Scheduling questions to ask any painter
body: These answers belong in writing, not just in conversation:
bullets: What is the expected start window after I approve the estimate?
How many working days will the exterior take?
How much dry time is planned after washing?
What happens to the schedule when rain moves in?
Will the same crew return after a weather delay?

body: Most projects start one to three weeks after approval. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time, and the schedule is written into the estimate. Precision Paint Experts uses its own crews rather than subcontractors, so the people who start your job are the people who come back to finish it after a storm pause.

Ocala sun is hard on color and sheen, especially on south and west walls. Our post on restoring sun-faded paint in Ocala covers what UV does to a finish, and our Ocala exterior painting page describes our full prep and product system for Marion County homes.

Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours. A crew lead measures, photographs conditions, and takes moisture readings where needed, and the itemized estimate usually follows within one business day. If you are aiming for a fall or winter start, getting estimates in hand early gives you time to compare bids without losing the best weeks of the season.

When you line up Ocala estimates, look past the start date to the assumptions behind it. A bid that promises a fast finish without mentioning dry time after washing, or without any plan for storm days, may simply be leaving those days off the page. Ask each contractor to walk you through a realistic week, rain included.

faqs.q: Can my Ocala home be painted in July?
faqs.a: Yes. We work earlier in the day during summer and watch dew point and radar closely, though October through May is the ideal window.

faqs.q: How long will a full exterior take?
faqs.a: Usually three to seven working days, plus time for washing and drying, depending on size and condition.
Most projects begin one to three weeks after the estimate is approved.
